role: directing frequency: a [0,1]-valued version of E(X_1 | exchangeable field) for a binary exchangeable sequence
notes: Random variable; same object as the limiting frequency of thm:p15-binary-definetti. Distinct from the Bayesian parameter-space symbol in the Bayesian updating chapter; scopes disjoint.

role: mixing law: the law of the directing frequency on [0,1]
notes: Same role as lambda in thm:p15-binary-definetti; reused, not redefined. Unrelated to lambda-abstraction and cardinal roles in P2-P7.

role: exchangeable binary law with mixing law lambda
notes: Subscript names the mixing law.

role: information of the first n outcomes, sigma(X_1,...,X_n); F_0 trivial
notes: Increasing filtration; not the exchangeable fields E_n of def:p15-exchangeable-canonical.

role: event that the first n outcomes form the word b
notes: Word notation local to this chapter.

role: predictive probability of the next outcome given F_n; atomwise version of P(X_{N+1}=1 | F_m)
notes: Random variables; superscript N indexes the predicted instance, not a power.

role: predictive probability along a fixed sequence under the mixing law lambda
notes: Defined only when the conditioning word has positive probability.

role: recoded outcome (equal to X_j up to N, flipped after N) and the recoding involution
notes: Binary counterpart of the fixed-cutoff predicate of def:p15-goodman-grue.

role: exchangeable law with uniform mixing for X; the law making the recoded sequence exchangeable with uniform mixing
notes: P' is also used in thm:p15-w02b-p15-022-reflection for a second exchangeable law; each use is declared locally.

role: stationary symmetric two-state chain law and its stay probability
notes: q in [0,1]; distinct from probability vectors named q in sec:p15-rationality-4-1.

role: algebra of finite-record events; event that the running frequency converges
notes: Local to the theorem and its annex proof.

role: future credence computed from a second exchangeable law
notes: Local to item 3.

role: sigma(S_n, X_{n+1}, ...) and its intersection
notes: Same role as in thm:p15-reverse-strong-law; reused.

role: a version of E(V|G) measurable for a second field H; the limsup of running averages used as a version of E(X_1|E)
notes: Local to the theorem and its annex proof; Y is the host lemma's conditional mean.

role: independent sign and size variables in the mean-independence example
notes: W is a random variable here, not the world space of thm:p15-w02b-p15-022-alternatives-contrast; scopes disjoint.

role: three-world space, its worlds, and the evidence event {w_2,w_3}
notes: Follows the world-space notation of def:p15-rat53-ranking; E is not the exchangeable field here.

role: possibility distribution 2^{-kappa} on worlds, its maxitive event extension, and its conditional on E
notes: Same roles as Poss/pi in sec:p15-r47-modal and thm:p15-ip-possibility-bridge; not the ratio pi of a circle.

role: nested basic mass assignment, its Dempster conditional on E, and the normalizing constant
notes: m and K as in def:p15-r47-mass and def:p15-r47-combination; K is not a belief set.

role: necessity image of a negative ranking
notes: Reused from def:p15-r47-ranking.

role: pignistic probability of m; two dominating probabilities and their mixtures
notes: Superscripts a,b are labels, not powers.

role: probability measures on an arbitrary measurable space with the evaluation sigma-field; evaluation maps; regular conditional law of X_1 given the exchangeable field; mixing law
notes: Same glyphs and roles as def:p15-directing-law, extended from standard Borel S to an arbitrary measurable space; on standard Borel S the objects coincide.

role: law of the repeated point; point mass at x
notes: Local to the example.
